item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00026","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C10","C08","C05"],"selected_candidate_label":"C10","confidence":0.88,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C10 plausibly supplied a material drafting template for C10's centralized interagency information-routing machinery, adapted from furnishing U.S. statistics to international organizations to obtaining foreign data through the Foreign Service. Both directives define the covered information, designate a central coordinating authority, route agency requests or outputs through that authority, require determinations governing what information will be handled and by whom, and mandate consultation with interested agencies with due consideration for their responsibilities or advice. The direction of information flow changes, but the administrative structure and several formulations remain substantially parallel. C08 and C05 also contain information-gathering, prioritization, and interagency coordination provisions, but these are embedded in defense-production systems and are less closely matched.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"As used in this order, the words \"foreign data\" shall mean any data obtained or to be obtained in foreign countries, including reports, statistics, and publications.","parent_excerpt":"the United Nations and other intergovernmental organizations ... have need for statistical information which can be supplied by the Government of the United States","explanation":"Both orders establish a defined information category for a government-wide system involving foreign or international channels."},{"child_excerpt":"the Department of State shall obtain for any Federal department or agency, through the Foreign Service of the United States, such foreign data as such department or agency may request through the Department of State","parent_excerpt":"shall determine which Federal executive agency or agencies shall prepare the statistical information thus to be provided. The statistical information so prepared shall be transmitted ... through established channels by the Secretary of State","explanation":"Both centralize interagency information traffic and route it through the Department of State or channels controlled by it."},{"child_excerpt":"the Department of State shall afford interested Federal departments and agencies opportunity for consultation and shall accord their advice appropriate consideration","parent_excerpt":"The Director's determination ... shall be made after consulting appropriate Federal executive agencies and giving due consideration to any responsibility now exercised by any of them","explanation":"This is a close and distinctive parallel consultation requirement, including the shared 'giving due consideration' formulation."}]}
